_comment: The 'Save and Exit' button in Diablo II's in-game (Esc) menu.
THE TEMPLATE IS THE TEXT, NOT THE BUTTON, AND THAT IS THE WHOLE POINT. All five menu
buttons share identical frame art, so the chrome is nearly all of the correlation and the
words are a rounding error. Measured on a real menu frame at 0.3x:
text only   best 0.936 vs 0.606 on another button - margin 0.331
full button best 0.900 vs 0.888                   - margin 0.013  (a coin flip)
Including more of the button makes it WORSE at telling the buttons apart, which is the
opposite of the intuition that a bigger template is a stronger match.
MATCHED AT FULL RESOLUTION, not on the pipeline's 0.3x frame - see main.py's quit_game().
Through the real code path, measured right-button vs best-wrong-button:
0.3x   0.793 vs 0.671  margin 0.122   (only 0.029 of headroom over a threshold of 0.70)
threshold 0.75 leaves +0.22 over the wrong button and +0.14 under the right one.
search_region is fractions of the ANCHOR WINDOW and covers the menu column only.
